title: Trading behavior in bitcoin futures: Following the “smart money”
summary: Positioning association is not a public Tuesday-entry strategy. Exact release vintages and combined-venue construction remain unverified; no returns tested.
about: Whether trader positioning anticipates weekly CME Bitcoin futures returns.
findings: Authors report2.13% mean weekly log return for their net-position-change rule, Jan2018–July2021. Tuesday-to-Tuesday returns start before public COT release. Table7's58.4% is down-week accuracy, not overall accuracy.
mechanism: Leveraged traders may possess timing information; this does not establish an edge available to a later public-data trader.
build_on: Park. Section2.2 combines CME and size-adjusted CBOE positions. Owned fields exist, but actual release vintages, combined-series parity and executable post-publication profitability are unverified. A later entry would be an adaptation.
can_strategy_code_be_made: A source-data audit is feasible; a faithful public-information return test is not admitted. No Tuesday look-ahead or invented release dates.
reading_scope: Selected primary HTML Sections2.1–2.2,3.2–3.5, Tables3–7/11 and data-availability text; figures and entire article not reviewed.
source_version: Baur and Smales; Journal of Futures Markets42(7),1304–1323; published27April2022.
owned_input_mapping: Owned2018–22BTC minute files and COT archives: CME133741 and CBOE1330E1 separately audited. Snapshot dates are not publication timestamps. No combined signal or price outcomes computed.
deeper_investigation: No deeper unchanged acquisition loop. Reconsider only on new source-matched release/venue/roll evidence supporting an executable later rule.
public_data_check: Paper's Cloudstor data link was inaccessible to the reader; no dataset acquired.
source_total_caution: Table6 total397.9% is not admitted as net compounded wealth; weekly source returns are logarithmic.
source_artifact_units: CME5BTC versus CBOE1BTC; combining raw contract counts without adjustment is not source parity.
